name: Kourou ELA-3
best_known_for: Ariane 5's home pad — JWST + Galileo + a quarter of geostationary commercial sats over a decade
credit: Ariane 5 pad at the Centre Spatial Guyanais near Kourou, French Guiana, 5.2°N. ELA-3 hosted every Ariane 5 mission from the maiden flight (Cluster, June 1996, that ended in vehicle loss) through the final flight VA261 in July 2023 (Heinrich Hertz + Syracuse 4B). Ariane 5 launched James Webb (December 2021), every Galileo navigation pair through 2014, BepiColombo, Rosetta, Herschel + Planck, JUICE, and the bulk of commercial Western geostationary traffic for two decades. ELA-4 next door now hosts Ariane 6. Coordinates from CNES + ESA records.
